consequence_logic.approve_everything: Bureaucracy grows; low-risk catalog buying slows; Procurement capacity is consumed.
consequence_logic.threshold_only: Risk/complexity below the threshold is missed; high-value routine purchases may be overprocessed.
consequence_logic.lowest_price: Continuity, capability, quality, time and stakeholder outcome are undervalued.
consequence_logic.contextual: Process intensity matches business need and Procurement effort is spent where it changes outcomes.

recovery: Re-route each request by business need, risk, market complexity, urgency and existing controls rather than one universal rule.
debrief_principle: Good Procurement is proportional. It is not maximum process; it is the right process for the value and risk at stake.
